patch_description: Add a third deterministic packing policy to threshold feasibility construction. Existing first-fit and best-fit policies only consider effective-size fragmentation. The new policy still enforces the effective-size capacity constraint required by the target KVPR, but selects among feasible GPUs by the projected actual maximum KVPR. This produces different feasible seeds that are more aligned with the real objective, allowing the existing move/swap refinement to start from stronger placements while retaining the robust fragmentation-oriented policies as fallbacks.
